ns2:course.label: Senior Research Project
ns2:course.description: Individual research project under the guidance of a faculty member: for example, mathematical analysis, laboratory experiments, computer simulations, software development, circuit design, or device fabrication. Preparation of a written research proposal, which includes preliminary results. 2 undergraduate hours. ECE 497 and eCE 499 taken in sequence fulfill the Advanced Composition Requirement. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: Senior standing; RHET 105; consent of instructor.
